newsitem.title: USA: Sen Roth urges Clinton to issue U.S. econ review.
newsitem.headline: Sen Roth urges Clinton to issue U.S. econ review.

text.p: Senate Finance Committee Chairman William Roth on Friday urged President Clinton to release the administration's mid-session review of the economy immediately.
The report, which had been due in mid-July, was postponed until Congress completes action on taxes and spending.
"It is expected that the economic report card will show that the economy is very strong and the deficit is continuing to shrink," Roth, a Delaware Republican, said.
Franklin Raines, director of the Office of Management and Budget, said earlier this month it made little sense to issue a report that would be quickly out of date.
